sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Hungarian usually marks plural nouns with -k. The form of the noun may change before the suffix.

Even though gyerek already ends in -k, the plural doesn't merge with it — you still add the full -ek: gyerek + ek = gyerekek. Hungarian plural suffixes attach to the whole stem; they don't swallow a matching final consonant the way you might expect.
